create_task_subclass: create a subclass of Task that implements root_entity and get_reward for a custom MuJoCo control problem
set_timesteps: set the control and physics timesteps on a Task instance using set_timesteps
create_nulltask: create a NullTask wrapping an Entity to build a Task with zero reward
customize_episode_initialization: override initialize_episode_mjcf and initialize_episode to randomize task conditions each episode
override_before_step: override before_step to map agent actions to custom actuator control signals
